── S-terra CSP VPN Gate ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
No entry existed for "csp-vpn-gate" / "sterra" - same two-tables-drifted class as
barracuda/sonicwall above. image_profiles.py already carries a live-repro-confirmed
note (2026-07-18) that this specific product (RHEL5/CentOS 5.3 base, IDE-only
initrd) panics in initramfs ("could not find filesystem '/dev/root'") when attached
over virtio - it must be "ide". Scoped to "csp-vpn-gate" only: the separate
"sterra-gate-4.x" product genuinely ships virtioa.qcow2 and must keep the virtio
default, so no generic "sterra" key is added here.
NPX-309: live-booted 2026-09-01 (lab npx309-sterra, image sterra-csp-vpn-gate-3.1) -
the VM boots fine and reaches "cspgate login:", but this RHEL5-base image's
GRUB/kernel sends console output to VGA (tty0), never to ttyS0. With console
set to "telnet" (serial), node-manager's serial.log stayed empty forever (1
byte) while a `virsh screenshot` of the VNC framebuffer showed the real login
prompt - so every operator connecting via netplex's console saw a silent
"hang" that was actually a live, healthy VM on the wrong console. Must be
"vnc", not "telnet".
